summary: Bullish (NYSE: BLSH) filed a Form 6-K announcing a definitive merger agreement to acquire Equiniti from Siris Capital in a transaction valued at approximately $4.2 billion. Consideration is payable in newly-issued Bullish ordinary shares valued based on the 30-day pre-signing VWAP of $38.4797 per share. The deal was approved by Bullish's board and is expected to close in Q1 2027. The merger agreement provides for the acquisition of two target entities (Cayman and US) through a two-step merger structure, making Equiniti wholly owned subsidiaries. An affiliate of the seller has an option to purchase non-core assets for $100 million cash. Closing is subject to regulatory approvals and customary conditions, with termination rights if not consummated by February 4, 2027 (with possible extensions). Watch for regulatory clearances and any shareholder vote; the all-stock consideration ties risk to Bullish's share price.
